//go:build e2e && svc_agents_orchestrator

package tests

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	zitiv1 "github.com/agynio/e2e/suites/go-core/.gen/go/agynio/api/ziti_management/v1"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/openziti/sdk-golang/ziti"
	"github.com/openziti/sdk-golang/ziti/enroll"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"
)

// Native transport proof of the Gateway's Ziti binding. /readyz only reports a
// router-confirmed terminator; this dials that terminator the way an agent
// workload does. The identity is synthetic, enrolled in memory and deleted;
// enrollment tokens and key material never reach logs.
const (
	gatewayProbeService = "gateway"
	// A new identity reaches the edge router through its data model, so the
	// first dials may be rejected; the bound keeps a stale router a failure.
	gatewayProbeDialBound    = 150 * time.Second
	gatewayProbeDialInterval = 2 * time.Second
)

var gatewayProbeSecrets = regexp.MustCompile(`eyJ[\w-]+\.[\w-]+\.[\w-]*|token=[^&\s"']+|pem:[^'"\s]+`)

type gatewayProbeDialError struct{ err error }

func (e gatewayProbeDialError) Error() string { return e.err.Error() }
func (e gatewayProbeDialError) Unwrap() error { return e.err }

func TestGatewayZitiNativeTransport(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	mgmt := zitiv1.NewZitiManagementServiceClient(dialGRPC(t, zitiManagementAddr(t)))

	agentID, workloadID := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
	created, err := mgmt.CreateAgentIdentity(ctx, &zitiv1.CreateAgentIdentityRequest{AgentId: agentID, WorkloadId: workloadID})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create synthetic agent identity: %v", err)
	}
	createdAt := time.Now()
	id, token := created.GetZitiIdentityId(), created.GetEnrollmentJwt()
	if id == "" || token == "" {
		t.Fatal("create synthetic agent identity: missing identity id or enrollment token")
	}
	t.Logf("synthetic agent instance %s (workload %s) has Ziti identity %s", agentID, workloadID, id)
	deleted := false
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if deleted {
			return
		}
		cleanupCtx, stop := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
		defer stop()
		if _, err := mgmt.DeleteIdentity(cleanupCtx, &zitiv1.DeleteIdentityRequest{ZitiIdentityId: id}); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("delete synthetic agent identity %s: %v", id, err)
		}
	})

	overlay, err := ziti.NewContext(enrollGatewayProbe(t, token))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("initialize native overlay: %s", redactGatewayProbe(err, token))
	}
	t.Cleanup(overlay.Close)
	client := &http.Client{Timeout: 20 * time.Second, Transport: &http.Transport{
		DisableKeepAlives: true,
		DialContext: func(ctx context.Context, _, _ string) (net.Conn, error) {
			conn, err := overlay.DialContext(ctx, gatewayProbeService)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, gatewayProbeDialError{err}
			}
			return conn, nil
		},
	}}

	code, body := getGatewayProbeMe(ctx, t, client, createdAt, token)
	if code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("native Gateway /me: status %d, want 200: %s", code, body)
	}
	var me struct {
		IdentityID   string `json:"identity_id"`
		IdentityType string `json:"identity_type"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(body), &me); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode native Gateway /me: %v", err)
	}
	// Only the Gateway resolves the dialing Ziti identity to this agent instance.
	if me.IdentityID != agentID || me.IdentityType != "agent_instance" {
		t.Fatalf("native Gateway /me resolved %q (%s), want synthetic agent instance %q", me.IdentityID, me.IdentityType, agentID)
	}
	liveness, err := mgmt.GetIdentityLiveness(ctx, &zitiv1.GetIdentityLivenessRequest{ZitiIdentityId: id})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("synthetic identity liveness: %v", err)
	}
	if liveness.GetEnrollmentState() != zitiv1.IdentityEnrollmentState_IDENTITY_ENROLLMENT_STATE_ENROLLED {
		t.Fatalf("synthetic identity enrollment state %s, want enrolled", liveness.GetEnrollmentState())
	}
	t.Logf("controller reports edge router connection for %s: %v", id, liveness.GetHasEdgeRouterConnection())

	// The raw TCP listener must never treat a credential-less request as a workload.
	base := strings.TrimRight(envOrDefault("AGYN_BASE_URL", "http://gateway:8080"), "/")
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, base+"/me", nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw, err := (&http.Client{Timeout: 20 * time.Second}).Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("raw TCP Gateway /me: %v", err)
	}
	rawBody, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(raw.Body, 4096))
	raw.Body.Close()
	if raw.StatusCode != http.StatusUnauthorized {
		t.Fatalf("raw TCP Gateway /me without credentials: status %d, want 401: %s", raw.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(rawBody)))
	}

	overlay.Close()
	if _, err := mgmt.DeleteIdentity(ctx, &zitiv1.DeleteIdentityRequest{ZitiIdentityId: id}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("delete synthetic agent identity %s: %v", id, err)
	}
	deleted = true
	if _, err := mgmt.ResolveIdentity(ctx, &zitiv1.ResolveIdentityRequest{ZitiIdentityId: id}); status.Code(err) != codes.NotFound {
		t.Fatalf("deleted synthetic identity %s still resolves: %v", id, err)
	}
	// ziti-management 0.13.0 reports a controller-side miss as "identity not found".
	if _, err := mgmt.GetIdentityLiveness(ctx, &zitiv1.GetIdentityLivenessRequest{ZitiIdentityId: id}); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "identity not found") {
		t.Fatalf("controller still reports deleted synthetic identity %s: %v", id, err)
	}
}

// enrollGatewayProbe enrolls with a generated in-memory key; no file is written.
func enrollGatewayProbe(t *testing.T, token string) *ziti.Config {
	t.Helper()
	claims, _, err := enroll.ParseToken(token)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("parse synthetic enrollment token: %s", redactGatewayProbe(err, token))
	}
	var keyAlg ziti.KeyAlgVar
	if err := keyAlg.Set("EC"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cfg, err := enroll.Enroll(enroll.EnrollmentFlags{Token: claims, KeyAlg: keyAlg})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("enroll synthetic agent identity in memory: %s", redactGatewayProbe(err, token, claims.ID))
	}
	return cfg
}

// getGatewayProbeMe retries only overlay dial failures. Once a connection is
// routed, the Gateway's answer is the result.
func getGatewayProbeMe(ctx context.Context, t *testing.T, client *http.Client, since time.Time, token string) (int, string) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(gatewayProbeDialBound)
	last := ""
	for attempt := 1; ; attempt++ {
		request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, "http://"+gatewayProbeService+"/me", nil)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		response, err := client.Do(request)
		if err == nil {
			body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 64<<10))
			response.Body.Close()
			t.Logf("Ziti service %q answered on attempt %d, %s after identity creation", gatewayProbeService, attempt, time.Since(since).Round(time.Millisecond))
			return response.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body))
		}
		var dialErr gatewayProbeDialError
		if !errors.As(err, &dialErr) {
			t.Fatalf("native Gateway request failed after dial: %s", redactGatewayProbe(err, token))
		}
		if message := redactGatewayProbe(dialErr, token); message != last {
			last = message
			t.Logf("Ziti service %q not dialable (attempt %d, %s after identity creation): %s", gatewayProbeService, attempt, time.Since(since).Round(time.Millisecond), message)
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatalf("Ziti service %q not dialable within %s: %s", gatewayProbeService, gatewayProbeDialBound, last)
		}
		time.Sleep(gatewayProbeDialInterval)
	}
}

func redactGatewayProbe(err error, secrets ...string) string {
	message := err.Error()
	for _, secret := range secrets {
		if secret != "" {
			message = strings.ReplaceAll(message, secret, "[redacted]")
		}
	}
	return gatewayProbeSecrets.ReplaceAllString(message, "[redacted]")
}
